name: Videniye
source:
This is the story of Alexander Novikov, a guy who lost all his relatives at an early age.
At the age of 20, he lives alone in a dacha settlement, not far from a small town.
June 2018.
His girlfriend comes to visit him for the summer holidays to complete an internship at the pedagogical institute where she studies. Her name is Nika.
Nika is the only person Sasha has left, the only person who will help him in a difficult moment.
For her internship, she chooses the themed camp Sovyonok, but she encounters problems getting situated, and she asks the protagonist to help her fill out her journal.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1697630634]Steam[/url]]
